notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Bug fixes patch:
- Fixed unavailable book in Portuguese version
- Fixed head flying off in Chasm scene
- Fixed title animation so it doesn't play every time you enter a room in the Prologue
- Fixed front door so it's not always open

notes.title: New Update! - April 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

New update, this time with more new stuff than fixes:

- Fixed Séculos achievement (finally!)
- Added Friend Games scene. You can see it by throwing your head out the kitchen window
- Developer commentary added. After finishing the game through the telephone you just need to raise the commentary volume on the options menu.
- New song: Irreal by Dimitria

Best wishes,
gools

notes.title: Our First Update Is Here! Details From the new v1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Finally the first patch for Century of Anticipation is here, fixing a lot of important stuff:

•⁠  ⁠Achievements fixed!
•⁠  ⁠The character now gets stronger when you work out, so you can throw the head further.
•⁠  ⁠Every time you eat you spend food from the fridge. You can enter the fridge after all the food is eaten.
•⁠  ⁠Trumpet now gets easier every time you practice.
•⁠  ⁠The full Sid The Prince story is now available.
•⁠  ⁠Other minor fixes I can’t remember right now

Now the game is in its intended shape, with a lot of the stuff that was hiding behind bugs now available. 

Best wishes,
gools
